text.p: The following is a fact file of Fabrizio Ravanelli, the Italian international striker who is remaining at relegated Middlesbrough next season.
1986 - Plays for his home-town club in the Italian third division before moving on to Avellino, Casertana (on loan) and Reggiana in serie B.
1992 - Signs for Juventus for 3 million pounds ($5 million) and makes serie A debut.
1994/5 - Wins Italian league and cup with Juventus, scoring 15 goals in 31 appearances and all five goals in a UEFA Cup tie against CSKA Sofia.
March 1995 - Makes debut for Italy, scoring in a 4-1 home win over Estonia.
1995/6 - Scores 12 times in 23 league appearances as Juventus finish runners-up in serie A. Scores in European Cup final as his club beat Ajax on penalties after a 1-1 draw in Rome.

1996/7 - Signs for Middlesbrough for 7 million pounds, scoring a hat-trick on his debut in 3-3 draw with Liverpool. Scores 31 goals but 'Boro are relegated after reaching the League and F.A.Cup finals.
1997 - Seeks transfer but fails to agree terms with various clubs. Opts to stay at Riverside stadium.
